precision: top/left/lastX are screen-quantised (+-0.3 pt); baseline/inkLeft and cell rectangles come from the 600 dpi PDF and are exact

lines.text: The quick survey of a quiet harbour town begins at dawn, when the fishing boats drift back past the
lighthouse and the market stalls fold open their striped awnings. Gulls wheel over the quay while
merchants argue cheerfully about the price of mackerel, and a baker carries warm loaves across the
cobbles to the cafe on the corner. By noon the visitors arrive, and the narrow streets fill with the sound
of voices, bicycle bells and distant music.
Typesetting depends on small decisions repeated thousands of times: where a line ends, how much
space follows a paragraph, and which words travel together across a page boundary. A faithful
reproduction must make exactly the same decisions, because one different break early in a document
moves every line that follows it onto a different page.
